changelog:
- Restored Player Controls: Player controls (play/pause arrows, 10s skip, fullscreen toggle, quality settings gear, 3-dots, timeline scrubber) remain interactive and reappear smoothly on tap.
- Shorts Auto-Play & Navigation Fix: Feed previews and Shorts no longer auto-advance or hijack user scrolling; swipe and tap controls restored naturally.
- True Immersive Fullscreen: Fullscreen auto-rotates to sensor landscape, completely hides status and navigation bars, and retains interactive on-screen controls.
- Performance & Smoothness: Removed redundant response clones and scoped DOM cleaners away from YouTube DOM for stutter-free scrolling.
- Clean Burn Session: Removed fire emoji from Burn Session menu action.
